## What this is
A single register tracing each **SCW16 benchmark (Lima)** outcome through its **TG-05** close-out to its **Wageningen** owner and status. Use it to drive the TG-05 call and then as the live status board during the workshop. Pair it with the [chair running sheet](SCW17-TG05-chair-running-sheet.html) and the [benchmark→MSE transition note (Doc01)](SCW17-Doc01-Benchmark-to-MSE-Transition.html).

**Status legend:** 🔒 closed/fixed · ⚠️ open — close at TG-05 · 🔁 carried to Wageningen · 📋 diagnostic only.
Items marked **[confirm]** are inferred from existing SCW17 materials and need checking against the SCW16 report.
**Updated:** `r date_stamp`
:::

# A. Items the benchmark closed (carry as fixed)

These need no decision at TG-05 — confirm they are correctly reflected in the OM and move on.

| # | Benchmark outcome | Status | Carried into | Owner at Wageningen |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | JJM assessment structure as MSE engine | 🔒 | OM conditioning (`conditionJJOM` → `FLjjm`) | WMR (Iago, Karolina) |
| A2 | Productivity grid `ll/ls/hl/hs` (steepness × SR period) | 🔒 | Reference-set OM axis | WMR |
| A3 | Fishery partition (N_Chile, SC_Chile_PS, FarNorth, Offshore_Trawl) | 🔒 | `split.is` catch allocation | WMR |
| A4 | Index set (Chile_AcousCS/N, Offshore_CPUE, Chile_CPUE, Peru_CPUE) | 🔒 | OEM + MP data streams | WMR |
| A5 | Reference-point framing: MSY sensitive, SPR / dynamic-B~zero~ stable | 🔒 framing | Status-metric convention (see B2) | Chair |

# B. Items TG-05 must close (the open list)

These are the six TG-05 decisions. Each must end the call either decided or replaced by its documented fallback.

| # | Open item | TG-05 slot | Decision needed | Fallback if not closed | Wageningen owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | Stock-hypothesis treatment (h1 / h2 / weighted) | 15:05–15:20 | How h1/h2 enter advice | Carry both as parallel axes; weight at Tue OM sign-off | Chair + WMR |
| B2 | Performance metrics, horizons (5/10/20 yr), risk band | 15:20–15:35 | Final metric list + risk tolerance | Adopt March working-papers list verbatim; revisit horizons only | Chair |
| B3 | **Freeze MP register** (data, lag, tuning, HCR, Buffer/K60) | 15:35–15:55 | Frozen candidate set; no new MPs after | Carry TG-04 set; new MPs comparison-only | WMR + Chile + Peru |
| B4 | Robustness scenario matrix + pass/fail criteria | 15:55–16:15 | Reference vs. robustness set; advancement criteria | TG-04 reference set + ENSO offshore-drop only | WMR |
| B5 | Cross-platform validation owners (FLR vs. RTMB/OpenMSE) | 16:15–16:25 | Named owners + deadlines | Chair appoints owners by name in minutes | WMR / Chile / Peru |
| B6 | Wageningen format + decision protocol | 16:25–16:30 | Trade-off display + report-out cadence | Chair proposes; circulate within 48 h | Chair |

# E. Post-TG-05 → Wageningen close-out chain

| When | Action | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Within 48 h of TG-05 | Circulate frozen decisions (B1–B6) + Wageningen-week agenda | Chair |
| Mon 15 Jun AM | Doc01 walkthrough; confirm fixed inputs (Section A) | Chair |
| Tue 16 Jun | Close C1–C4; OM block sign-off | WMR + Chair |
| Wed 17 Jun | First integrated CMP results on reference OM | WMR |
| Thu 18 Jun PM | **CMP shortlist for SC14 decided** | Chair (plenary) |
| Fri 19 Jun | Shortlist rationale; exceptional-circumstances meta-rules; SC14 drafting assignments | Chair |
| TT-06 (Thu 9 Jul) | Post-Wageningen review | Chair |

# How to use this during the call

Run top to bottom. Section A is a 60-second confirmation. Section B is the meeting — each row gets its time-box, and you mark it 🔒 (closed) or note the fallback invoked. Sections C and D you only touch if a member tries to re-open something that is already assigned to the workshop or parked as diagnostic — point at the row and move on.
